reviews.title: Flawless Monitor. Amazon, Send Me Another...
reviews.comment: So far so good. I purchased another monitor and the VESA was embedded into a cutout in the monitor. This made my mount not fit so I returned it for this one. Unfortunately I had to pay a little more for it. That said, the quality is pretty amazing. There's an obvious color, resolution, and quality difference to my other two ASUS monitors (27"). I'm probably going to replace one of them with another one of these. Because the VESA on this monitor is flush with the curve, setup literally took 3 minutes to screw in the plate and drop it into my desk arm. You can see this monitor on the right in the attached image.
reviews.author: T. J. Young

reviews.title: Dark area screen. Faulty monitor
reviews.comment: I've had this for a few days and can count how many times i used this monitor because I strictly use this for work. I've had this for 2 and half weeks and used it 6 times for editing music and word document. When turned it on today I noticed there is a dark area in the middle of the screen. It was a good monitor at first. I guess its a gamble with budget monitor
reviews.author: Paul J.P
